_readme: Auralis in-app copy. Edit here, save, and the app picks it up on next launch (cached — allow a minute). Every _previous_* key records the wording this field replaced, so you can restore it exactly. WARNING: whatever you put here is a public claim. App Store guideline 2.3.1 requires in-app claims to be accurate (a rating or user count that does not exist is grounds for removal, not just rejection) and 1.1.1 forbids mean-spirited content. An empty string hides that element.

reminderStat: One well-timed daily nudge is what keeps the routine alive on the days you are busy.
_previous_reminderStat: One well-timed daily nudge — members who keep it on progress about 38% faster.
_tierHelp: Lowest → highest, 5 entries required (thresholds stay in code: 52 / 66 / 78 / 88). This is the label the user sees for their own face — the previous ladder is the highest-risk item under 1.1.1.

socialProof._previous_rating: ratingEnabled true, ratingValue '4.6', ratingCaption 'App Store rating' — shown as a pill on the plan page and in the social-proof step
socialProof._ratingHelp: Turn on only once your App Store product page actually shows a rating. If the number is not from the App Store, say so in ratingCaption (e.g. 'Rated by our early testers').
socialProof._previous_counts: memberCount '75,000+', scanCount '260,000+', transformationsLabel '65,000+ transformations powered by Auralis'  (the social-proof step also had a green pill: '225 scans in the last 24 hours', now replaced by 'Nothing leaves your device')
socialProof._countHelp: Empty string hides the element and the screen falls back to verifiable facts (20 measurements, 7 categories, 39 lessons). Fill these only with numbers you can back with a screenshot.
socialProof._previous_liveTicker: true — plan page footer: 'N people started their transformation in the last hour', starting at 187 and incrementing on a 9s timer
socialProof._tickerHelp: The counter is a timer, not real data. When false the footer shows 'Everything is measured and stored on your device'.
socialProof._previous_testimonials: testimonialsIllustrative false — no 'Illustrative example' badge on any quote; reviews step header read 'Trusted by Thousands' with 'Over 75,000+ members'
socialProof._testimonialHelp: testimonialsIllustrative adds a visible 'Illustrative example' badge to the quotes. Set false only for quotes from real, consenting users.
